summary: This note is a short Wikipedia-style biographical entry for Anil B. Divan, an Indian senior advocate. It gives his birth and death dates and describes him as an eminent constitutional expert. The note is very brief and contains no further career details.
one_line: Anil B. Divan was an Indian senior advocate, described as an eminent constitutional expert, who lived from 1930 to 2017.
key_facts: Anil B. Divan was born on 15 May 1930.
Anil B. Divan died on 20 March 2017.
Anil B. Divan was a senior advocate in India.
Anil B. Divan has been described as an eminent constitutional expert.
